Change c0361. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. II; 1831 Ch. XIX.

Context before (unchanged): The latter name made me tremble, when pronounced by Henry; and I hastened to quit Matlock, with which that terrible scene was thus associated.

1818 text: From Derby still journeying northward, we passed two months in Cumberland and Westmoreland.

1831 text: From Derby, still journeying northward, we passed two months in Cumberland and Westmorland.

Diff: From Derby {+,+} still journeying northward, we passed two months in Cumberland and [-Westmoreland-] {+Westmorland+} .

Context after (unchanged): I could now almost fancy myself among the Swiss mountains.

result.rationale: "Westmoreland" becomes "Westmorland", an orthographic variant of the county name. A comma is also added after "Derby", which is punctuation only. Neither change affects meaning.
